acceptance_tests: An open availability question clears only the specific rejected-time constraint and queries the current appointment date/context.
A successful local SQLite lookup always produces a response grounded in its structured result.
A requested date with no slots remains unchanged and any nearby alternative is explicitly labeled with its full date and time.
An unavailable proposed time never creates a pending offer and cannot be booked by a later affirmation.
Only a complete AVAILABLE tool-backed pending offer may advance to create_appointment.
Existing appointment, temporal, Final Admission, realtime, Played Audio and Cost Ledger invariants remain green.
actual_behavior: Follow-up availability questions repeated the previously rejected requested time or produced no tool call.
The no-tool path allowed a response claiming local availability could not be retrieved.
A later affirmation caused another lookup of an unavailable proposal instead of confirming only a valid offer.
expected_behavior: A general availability question searches the active appointment context without the stale rejected preferred time.
The reply reports exact-date availability or explicitly dated nearby alternatives from SQLite.
Successful local demo lookups are never described as inaccessible live data.
Unavailable times never become pending offers or confirmation targets.
protected_invariants: The deterministic temporal resolver owns the requested ISO date and weekday.
SQLite tool results own availability and transaction truth.
A pending offer is atomic, AVAILABLE, tool-backed and appointment-scoped.
No booking occurs without explicit confirmation and successful SQLite commit.
Voice, Final Admission, barge-in, backchannel, Played Audio and Cost Ledger behavior is unchanged.

steps: Request an Orthopädie appointment for Wednesday in three weeks at 11:30.
Observe UNAVAILABLE for the exact requested time.
Ask which time or appointment time is free.
Ask again which time is actually free.
Affirm that 12:00 is acceptable although it was never offered as AVAILABLE.
